name: Tearsheet
description: Free, accessible UI components in HTML + CSS, React, Vue and Svelte, with notes on why they work, plus a web design guide.
usage: Every component reads its colours, radii and focus ring from tokens.css (CSS custom properties). Include tokens.css once, globally, then add component files.

components.name: Buttons
components.description: Primary, secondary, ghost and destructive buttons with hover, focus and disabled states.
components.notes: Use one primary button per view. Label with a verb (“Save changes”, not “Submit”). Use <button> for actions and <a> for navigation.

components.name: Toggle button group
components.description: A formatting toolbar of joined icon buttons that each switch on and off.
components.notes: Each button reports its state with aria-pressed, and the group has a role="toolbar" label. Icon-only buttons always carry an aria-label.
components.checked: axe clean in light and dark; 1 tab stop; fits a phone in RTL with Arabic: yes; with 40% longer text: yes; contrast holds with a fitted brand: yes

components.name: Split button
